goal: Independently QA the WP-037 Phase 4B direct art Godot integration for scope compliance, deterministic verification, visual readability, import stability, gameplay regression risk, label/HUD readability, and readiness for BK/Human Creative Owner play/feel review.
forbidden_changes: final BK/Human Creative Owner play-feel approval

verify.name: Direct art files exist
verify.command: for asset in background_section_one_v1 background_section_two_v1 player_avatar_v1 ground_platform_tile_v1 collectible_progression_item_v1 hazard_warning_marker_v1 goal_marker_v1 ui_status_panel_v1; do test -f "game/assets/phase4b/direct_art/${asset}.png" && test -f "game/assets/phase4b/direct_art/${asset}.png.import"; done

verify.name: Godot import cache can be regenerated
Headless scene runtime output is clean
verify.command: bash -lc 'out=$(godot --headless --path game --scene res://scenes/main.tscn --quit-after 3 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR|Parse Error|Failed" <<< "$out"'

verify.name: Scene references all direct art assets
Core gameplay markers and labels remain
WP-037 implementation touched only authorized files
verify.command: git show --name-only --format= 523015955f78f4a2c6a87423086cc4c87ec9d348 | sed '/^$/d' | sort | diff -u <(printf '%s\n' game/scenes/main.tscn runs/RUN-20260620-001.json work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-037.json | sort) -

acceptance_criteria: QA does not modify implementation files under review.
QA checks WP-037 against the Phase 4B brief, BK direct art approval, and user-approved grill constraints.
QA validates Godot import, clean smoke output, and clean headless scene runtime after import-cache regeneration.
QA confirms all eight direct art assets are referenced by the scene and remain prototype-only / production-candidate, not production-approved.
QA confirms Section 1 and Section 2 backgrounds are visual-only backdrops and do not replace gameplay objects, collision, hazard, or goal logic.
QA confirms core labels remain visible enough for first-pass readability: HAZARD, ITEM, Goal, and section/status labels.
QA checks whether player, platform, collectible, hazard, goal, HUD text, and background detail remain readable at gameplay scale.
QA confirms player.gd was not changed by WP-037 and movement, hazard fail, collectible/progression, goal, timer, and retry behavior were not intentionally changed.
QA identifies actionable rework issues if deterministic checks, scope, readability, or playability-readiness fail.
QA recommendation does not replace BK/Human Creative Owner direct play/feel approval after the art-integrated version.
notes: This Work Package is the independent QA handoff for WP-037. It should be executed by QA, not by the implementation pass. It may recommend pass, rework, or blocked, but it cannot approve final play/feel, final art direction, production asset usage, launch/public use, or edit implementation files.
